title: The Rope Turn for the One Watching
youtube_title: The Rope Turn for the One Watching | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Cosima is just outside the fun, close to a jump rope turning while someone only watched. Yelena changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Cosima has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
